title: 第5章 族长的偏袒第6章 祭祖大典
content_zh:
“林炎，我错了！这次我是真的错了，我给你磕头了！求求你，别杀我！”
林龙身体不断的颤抖，恨不得要跪下去舔林炎的脚趾头。
身为林家少主，他是第一次体会到死亡的恐惧。
以往的时候，他不管遇到多大的麻烦，都始终有林家当靠山。
可现在，他的靠山没用了！
林炎是一个疯子，根本不在乎他的威胁的疯子！
“你践踏我尊严的时候，怎么也不想想后果呢？你今日就是说破天，我也要诛杀你！”
林炎质问，眼中闪过一抹恨意。
如果不是林龙，他的家庭也不至于被破坏成这幅样子。
虽然这里面也有陆青青的错，甚至很大，可这一切的罪魁祸首，就是林龙！
砰！
没有再给林龙辩解的机会，他手掌一捏，就将林龙的脑袋给捏爆了。
大仇得报！
林炎心中的压抑，也在这一刻一扫而空。
将两人斩杀后，林炎运转九龙吞天诀，吞噬两人的修为之力。
林耀东和林龙，虽然都不是天才，可毕竟也是修炼多年，那些气血之力也是不少，林炎的修为节节攀升。
养气六重！
最终，林炎突破到了养气六重！
“咔嚓！”
在林炎斩杀林龙的同时，林家的一座密室中，一个模样与林龙有几分相似的青年猛地睁开了眼睛：

“嗯？林龙死了？”
“该死！那可是我花费多年培养的炉鼎！原本等到林龙十八岁，我就可以吞噬其本命精元了，只差几个月啊！”
“我不管你是谁，坏了我的计划，我都要让你死无葬身之地！”
轰！
密室破开，一股强横的气息冲天而起。
“那个方位，是林虎少爷的，怎么回事？林虎少爷出关了？”
“不清楚，不过林虎少爷似乎朝着林龙少爷的府邸去了，而且看他的气息似乎非常的阴冷，貌似有不好的事情发生！”
整个林家，都随之掀起一阵骚动，无数弟子都朝着林龙的府邸赶去，想要看看到底发生了什么。
林炎刚完成吞噬，就忽然察觉到一股狂暴的气息极速而来。
这让林炎心头一沉：“是林虎，这家伙的反应怎么这么快？”
林虎，是林龙的亲兄弟。
两人都是大长老林雄之子。
不过和林龙不同的是，林虎乃是真正的武道天才，也是如今林家的第一天才，修为达到了养气九重！
距离气海境只差一步之遥！
就算是三长老林耀东，在林虎面前，也都如同蝼蚁般孱弱！
“我虽不惧怕林虎，可林虎背后站着整个林家，死磕的话不划算，现在先离开林家，等以后修为提升上来再来报仇！”
林炎目光一闪。
然而林虎的速度太快了，还不等林炎离开府邸，林虎就已经率领自己的部下，将整个府邸围困：
“所有人，给我看守住林龙的府邸，一只苍蝇都不能飞走！”
“是！”
content_en:
"Lin Yan, I was wrong! This time I was really wrong. I kowtow to you! Please, don't kill me!"
Lin Long's body kept trembling, and he wanted to kneel down and lick Lin Yan's toes.
As the young master of the Lin family, this was the first time he experienced the fear of death.
In the past, no matter how much trouble he encountered, he always had the Lin family as his backer.
But now, his backer is useless!
Lin Yan is a madman, a madman who doesn't care about his threats at all!
"When you trampled on my dignity, why didn't you think about the consequences? Even if you talk about breaking the sky today, I will kill you!"
Lin Yan asked, a trace of hatred flashed in his eyes.
If it weren't for Lin Long, his family wouldn't have been destroyed like this.
Although there is Lu Qingqing's fault in this, even a big one, the culprit of all this is Lin Long!
Bang!
Without giving Lin Long a chance to defend himself, he crushed Lin Long's head with a squeeze of his palm.
Great revenge must be avenged!
The depression in Lin Yan's heart was also swept away at this moment.
After killing the two men, Lin Yan used the Nine Dragons Devouring Heaven Technique to swallow up the power of their cultivation.
Although Lin Yaodong and Lin Long are not geniuses, they have practiced for many years and have a lot of energy and blood. Lin Yan's cultivation level is rising steadily.
The sixth level of nourishing qi!
Finally, Lin Yan broke through to the sixth level of Qi nourishment!
"Crack!"
While Lin Yan was killing Lin Long, in a secret room of the Lin family, a young man who looked somewhat similar to Lin Long suddenly opened his eyes:
"Huh? Lin Long is dead?"
"Damn it! That's the cauldron I spent many years cultivating! Originally, when Lin Long turned eighteen, I could devour his life essence, which was only a few months away!"
"I don't care who you are, if you ruin my plan, I will let you die without a burial place!"
Boom!
The secret room was broken open, and a powerful aura rose into the sky.
"That direction belongs to Young Master Lin Hu. What's going on? Young Master Lin Hu is out of seclusion?"
"I don't know, but Master Lin Hu seems to be heading towards Master Lin Long's mansion, and his aura seems to be very cold. It seems like something bad has happened!"
There was a commotion in the entire Lin family, and countless disciples rushed towards Lin Long's mansion, wanting to see what happened.
As soon as Lin Yan finished devouring it, he suddenly noticed a violent aura coming at a very fast speed.
This made Lin Yan's heart sink: "It's Lin Hu, why does this guy react so quickly?"
Lin Hu is Lin Long’s biological brother.
Both of them are the sons of the Great Elder Lin Xiong.
But unlike Lin Long, Lin Hu is a true martial arts genius, and is now the number one genius in the Lin family. His cultivation has reached the ninth level of qi nourishing!
It’s only one step away from the Qi Sea Realm!
Even the Third Elder Lin Yaodong was as weak as an ant in front of Lin Hu!
"Although I'm not afraid of Lin Hu, the entire Lin family is standing behind Lin Hu. It's not worthwhile to fight to the death. Leave the Lin family now and take revenge later when your cultivation level improves!"
Lin Yan's eyes flashed.
However, Lin Hu's speed was too fast. Before Lin Yan could leave the mansion, Lin Hu had already led his men to surround the entire mansion:
"Everyone, guard Lin Long's mansion for me. Not even a fly can fly away!"
"Yes!"
